title: MEGA: Multilingual Evaluation of Generative AI
what_it_does: First comprehensive multilingual benchmarking of generative LLMs on 16 datasets across 70 languages vs SOTA fine-tuned models.
key_results: Generative LLMs lag substantially on many non-English (especially low-resource, non-Latin-script) languages; extended later by MEGAVERSE.
drawbacks: Classic reference-based metrics over standard tasks; measures task accuracy, not reliability of evaluation methods.
gap_vs_ours: Benchmarks capability per language but never controls script or examines judge scoring across scripts.

title: IndicGenBench: A Multilingual Benchmark to Evaluate Generation Capabilities of LLMs on Indic Languages
what_it_does: Human-curated multi-way parallel generation benchmark (summarization, MT, QA) over 29 Indic languages spanning 13 scripts.
key_results: Every Indic language shows a significant gap vs English; lower-resource languages degrade most.
drawbacks: Automatic reference-based metrics rather than LLM/human judges; each language tested only in its conventional script.
gap_vs_ours: Covers 13 native scripts but never the same language in two scripts, so romanized-vs-native judge bias is untestable on it.

title: MILU: A Multi-task Indic Language Understanding Benchmark
what_it_does: India-centric multiple-choice benchmark, ~85K questions, 8 domains, 41 subjects, 11 Indic languages from regional exams.
key_results: Best model (GPT-4o) reaches only 74% average; language-specific fine-tuned models barely above random; drops on low-resource languages and cultural domains.
drawbacks: Multiple-choice accuracy sidesteps generation evaluation and judge reliability entirely.
gap_vs_ours: Native-script only, exact-match scored; no lever to detect script-driven bias in model-based scoring.

title: Airavata: Introducing Hindi Instruction-tuned LLM
what_it_does: Hindi instruction-tuned LLM (fine-tuned OpenHathi on IndicInstruct) with Hindi evaluation benchmarks including GPT-4-judged generation quality.
key_results: Outperforms base OpenHathi on most Hindi NLU/NLG tasks, demonstrating the value of Hindi instruction tuning.
drawbacks: LLM-judged evaluation adopted uncritically, without validating the judge against human raters.
gap_vs_ours: Evaluates Hindi in Devanagari only; never asks whether the GPT-4 judge would score the same content differently if romanized. Exemplifies the practice our study audits.

title: METAL: Towards Multilingual Meta-Evaluation
what_it_does: Meta-evaluation dataset of 1,000 summaries across 10 languages with native-speaker judgments on 5 dimensions; measures LLM-judge/human agreement.
key_results: GPT-4 judges agree best with native speakers; GPT-3.5-Turbo poor; LLM evaluators' stated reasoning often mismatches human judges' reasoning.
gap_vs_ours: Judge-human agreement per language in standard script only; script-controlled judge sensitivity unexamined.
